title: A Sick People

04 Aug, 2026

Every time I leave the US, I’m always struck by how happy other people seem to be. I’ve been to six continents, dozens of countries. Nowhere else have I experienced such deeply internalized bitterness, entitlement, and misanthropy as I do back home. There’s something wrong here. We’re not well.

I’m recently back from Baja California Sur. The Mexican people never cease to amaze me. They’re some of the kindest people on Earth. Actually, I think I say that about everywhere I travel. Except for Paris. The rest of France, cool, but Parisians, no way.

I’ve often tried to pinpoint the root cause of our cultural malaise, but to no avail. Everyone is always on edge, teetering on the brink of violence. By and large, we’re fat, lazy, poorly educated, and blind to the state of things. It’s embarrassing.

I think a part of it is the individualism we’re raised to embrace. The old image of the frontiersman, pulling himself up by his bootstraps and conquering the west. We make our own way. It seems like that attitude has mutated into a hubristic solipsism that demands immediate satisfaction.

We don’t care for our children, our elderly, or our communities. It’s all me me me. How do I get mine and fuck the other guy.

It’s a shame, and it’s also contagious. I can feel it creeping into my bones. The longer I stay here, the worse it will get.

#reflections

户主卡尔

04 Aug, 2026

每次我离开美国时，我总是被其他人的快乐所震惊。 我去过六大洲，几十个国家。 在其他任何地方，我都没有像在家乡那样经历过如此深刻的内心痛苦、权利和厌世情绪。 这里有问题。 我们不好。

我最近从南下加利福尼亚州回来。 墨西哥人民总是让我惊叹不已。 他们是地球上最善良的人。 事实上，我想无论我去哪里旅行，我都会这么说。 除了巴黎。 法国其他地方很酷，但巴黎人不行。

我经常试图找出我们文化问题的根源，但无济于事。 每个人总是处于边缘，在暴力的边缘摇摇欲坠。 总的来说，我们肥胖、懒惰、受教育程度低，而且对事物的现状视而不见。 真尴尬。

我认为其中一部分原因是我们从小就接受的个人主义。 边民的旧形象，自力更生，征服西方。 我们走自己的路。 这种态度似乎已经转变为一种要求立即满足的傲慢唯我论。

我们不关心我们的孩子、老人或我们的社区。 都是我我我。 我如何得到我的并操另一个人。

这是一种耻辱，而且还具有传染性。 我能感觉到它渗入我的骨头。 我在这里待的时间越长，情况就会变得越糟。

#反思
